# Quickstart: Schemas Directory UI (ODA‑style)

This feature delivers a static, client-rendered UI to browse schemas under `schemas/`.

## What you'll need
- Node.js LTS (if/when implementing the UI)
- GitHub Pages (or any static host) for deployment

## Planned workflow (no code generated by this plan)
1. Add a script to generate `public/schemas-index.json` by scanning `schemas/`.
2. Build a client-side UI to consume that index, render a directory, and view schemas.
3. Ensure static export produces a deterministic `out/` for GitHub Pages.

## Data contract
- The `schemas-index.json` file MUST conform to `contracts/schemas-index.schema.json`.

## Accessibility & Performance
- Semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, and sufficient contrast.
- Keep bundles light; avoid unnecessary dependencies.

## Deploying to GitHub Pages (conceptual)
- Export a static site and publish the export directory.
- Use a base path if deploying under a subpath.
